pluginText.pf.license: {"need":"if a contractor or home improvement license where the state or local rules require one (some only above a job size), else a business registration on file; nothing is looked up","ask":"the license or registration number and the state it's from","holds":"the business (a qualifying person on its behalf, where the state's form says so)","checked":"The business's own word, never checked by Rosie (MC:C7).","blocks":"no install over the license's job-size limit, where the state's form sets one; a lapsed license stops new bookings for that work","insurance":"general liability, and workers' comp for a crew, where the state's form requires it; the certificate on file","renewals":"The business's own word, never checked by Rosie (MC:C7). reminded before it lapses"}
pluginText.pf.services: [{"name":"Free on-site estimate","place":"the customer's place","price":"free (nothing before, nothing after)","length":"45 to 60 minutes","note":"measures the line, looks at slope, gates and old fence; the install is priced at it as a written estimate"},{"name":"New fence install (wood, vinyl, chain link, aluminum)","place":"the customer's place","price":"per foot, quoted at the estimate visit (written estimate), or from photos and the customer's measurements","length":"1 to 3 days with a crew of 2 or 3","money":"a deposit when the written estimate is signed (materials are ordered with it); the rest on the bill when it's done"},{"name":"Gate install or gate repair","place":"the customer's place","price":"the example shop's own list: gate repair $175, a new walk gate from $450","length":"1 to 3 hours","money":"nothing before; the bill after"},{"name":"Fence repair (posts, panels, boards)","place":"the customer's place","price":"quoted from photos first, or at the visit","length":"2 to 4 hours","money":"nothing before; the bill after"},{"name":"Old fence removal and haul-away","place":"the customer's place","price":"per foot, added to an install","length":"part of the install"},{"name":"Stain and seal a wood fence","place":"the customer's place","price":"per foot, quoted from photos or at the visit","length":"1 day; needs dry weather"},{"name":"Design consult (flow A)","place":"the showroom, or by video","price":"free","length":"30 minutes","note":"picks a style, material and height from samples; nothing is measured; the estimate visit follows at the customer's place"}]
pluginText.pf.questions: {"before_times":["the property's address","what's needed: a new fence, a repair, a gate, or stain","about how many feet, and the height and material wanted","is there an old fence to take out","is it around a pool (a pool fence has its own barrier rules)","does the customer own the property, or have the owner's OK"],"after_time":["the way into the yard and any gate code (on the secure page)","dogs that will be in the yard on work days","known private lines the public locate doesn't mark: sprinklers, a pet fence, outdoor lighting, a gas line to a grill or pool heater, septic","an HOA that must approve the fence, and its approval if they have it","where the property line is: a survey or plat if they have one"],"secure_page_only":["a gate or lockbox code","a survey or plat document"],"who_may_book":"an adult who owns the property, or someone the owner authorizes on a forwarded link (a renter or a property manager); never a minor"}
pluginText.pf.safety: {"stop_words":["a gas smell","a hit gas line","a downed power line","sparks or a live wire","someone hurt by a tool or a falling post"],"tell_customer":"Gas smell or a hit gas line: leave the area now, and call 911 and the gas company from away. A downed power line: stay far away and call 911 and the power company. No booking until it's safe.","continue":"a fence knocked down by a storm or a car is booked once the area is safe (no lines down)","on_the_job":"no digging until the public utility locate marks are in; the crew stops at once if a line is hit or a mark is near the hole; pets and children kept inside while the crew works; the yard can be open while the old fence is out"}
pluginText.pf.first_steps: [{"step":"the estimate visit (measure and written estimate)","before":"every new install","timing":"booked first, as its own visit"},{"step":"the written estimate signed and the deposit paid","before":"materials are ordered","timing":"materials take 1 to 3 weeks; the install day is set after they arrive"},{"step":"the public utility locate (call before you dig)","who":"the business asks for it","timing":"a few business days before digging; no digging until the lines are marked"},{"step":"a fence permit, where the local rules require one","who":"the business pulls it unless the owner wants to","timing":"the times start after its lead time; no work before it's approved"},{"step":"HOA approval, where there is an HOA","who":"the customer gets it","timing":"before the install day"},{"step":"the property line confirmed","who":"the customer (a survey or plat where unsure)","timing":"before the install day; the crew never sets a fence on a line the customer can't confirm"}]
pluginText.pf.visit: {"check_in":"estimate visits: the customer's code at the door; install days: the code if someone's home, else nobody needs to be home when the yard is open (DONE with photos)","work_changes":"rock or roots found while digging (priced per hole, the customer's yes first); more old fence to remove; a gate added; any change is priced and the customer says yes first","proof":"DONE with photos of the finished fence and gates; a walk-through with the customer when they're home","multiday":"posts set in concrete on day 1, panels or chain link on day 2 once it cures"}
pluginText.pf.money: {"defaults":"estimate visit free; installs: a deposit when the written estimate is signed, the rest on the bill when it's done; repairs and gates: nothing before, the bill after","deposit_cap":"where the state caps a home improvement deposit, the cap from the state's form, shown as a suggested rule","bank_transfer":"big install bills may be paid by bank transfer","materials":"custom materials ordered for the job: a cancel after the order keeps only what the signed estimate's schedule says, from money already taken","tips":"no tip line","tax":"the business's own tax setting","rosfield_fee":"$2 per confirmed booking (not a health practice or a law firm)"}
pluginText.pf.messages: {"never_in_text":"gate or lockbox codes, money details","languages":"English and Spanish","minors":"not served; a minor can't book"}
pluginText.pf.staff: {"roles":"an estimator (measures and writes the estimate) and install crews (a crew lead and 1 or 2 helpers)","license":"the crew lead or the business holds any license the state's form asks; helpers work under the crew lead","stand_in":"any crew lead with the skill may take an install; the estimator who wrote the estimate needn't be there","who_oks":"the owner OKs quotes over their limit"}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"written_contract":"a written estimate signed before an install, where the state's form requires one above an amount","cancel_period":"work sold at the customer's place: the written cancel period where the state's form gives one (switch cancelright)","license_number":"on estimates and bills, where the state's form requires it","permits":"a fence permit where the local rules require one; height and pool barrier rules from the local rules","records":"estimates, contracts and photos kept 7 years","warranty":"the business's own workmanship warranty (for example 1 year)"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"weather":"rain, frozen ground or a storm: concrete can't set; the business moves the day (the business can't give it)","rock":"rock or roots in a post hole: extra per hole, priced first, the customer's yes","line_hit":"a utility line hit: stop, safety first, the owner told","property_line":"a neighbor disputes the line: the work stops on that side until the customer settles it","materials_late":"materials not in by the install day: the business moves the day","nobody_home":"fine when the yard is open and the way in is on the secure page","dog":"a dog loose in the yard: the crew doesn't go in; the customer is asked to bring it in","hoa":"HOA approval not in by the install day: the customer's side; the day moves"}
